webster.text: Unchangeable; invariable; unalterable; not capable or susceptible of change.

example.quote: They have supposed, that the deity, from the relations, we stand in, to himself and to each other, has constituted an eternal and immutable law, which is, indispensably, obligatory upon all mankind, prior to any human institution whatever.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, The Farmer Refuted (Feb. 23, 1775) (excerpt, Teaching American History)
